newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends at highs, cocoa drifts lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends at highs, cocoa drifts lower.

text.p: COFFEE - Origin sales shave early gains, but contracts return to session highs at the close. March ends up $32 at $1,265. COCOA - Off lows in slow session. Market notes weaker arrivals news from Ghana and Ivory Coast. March down three stg at 931. SUGAR - Claws back lost ground as NY consolidates but front spreads stay flat. March down $1.00 at $296.90 at 1700 GMT.
